name: EGNN
tagline: E(n)-equivariant message passing that jointly updates node features and 3D coordinates using Euclidean distances between nodes.
formula: $$m_{ij} = \psi_h(h_i, h_j, \|x_i - x_j\|^2),\;\; x_i' = x_i + \sum_{j} \frac{x_i - x_j}{\|x_i-x_j\|+1} \psi_x(m_{ij}),\;\; h_i' = h_i + \phi(h_i, \sum_j m_{ij})$$
diff_from_baseline: Satorras et al., ICML 2021 (E(n) Equivariant Graph Neural Networks). Standard E(n)-equivariant encoder used as a strong geometry-aware reference for protein-graph representation learning. Hyperparameters match ProteinWorkshop's egnn.yaml.

name: GearNet
tagline: Geometric relational GNN with seven edge types (sequential offsets, radius, kNN) and per-relation linear updates with concat-hidden readout.
pseudocode:
1. Build edges: 5 sequential offsets {-2,-1,0,1,2}, radius graph (cutoff=10), kNN graph (k=16)
2. Build edge feature $e_{ij} = [h_i \| h_j \| \text{onehot}(r) \| |i-j| \| \|p_i-p_j\|]$
3. For each layer $\ell$ and relation $r$:
   $\quad m_{ij}^{(r)} = h_i \cdot \sigma(W_e e_{ij})$
   $\quad u_{j}^{(r)} = \sum_{i: r(i,j)=r} m_{ij}^{(r)}$
4. $h_j' = \text{ReLU}(W \cdot \text{concat}_r(u_j^{(r)}) + W_{self} h_j)$
5. Add short-cut residual, BatchNorm, dropout
6. Readout = sum-pool over concatenated hidden states from all layers
diff_from_baseline: Zhang et al., ICLR 2023 (Protein Representation Learning by Geometric Structure Pretraining). Multi-relational geometric encoder with sequential, radius, and kNN edge types - the canonical GNN baseline on ProteinWorkshop. Hyperparameters match gear_net.yaml.

name: SchNet
tagline: Continuous-filter convolutions over a kNN graph with Gaussian RBF distance expansion and shifted-softplus nonlinearity, invariant to rotation/translation.
diff_from_baseline: Schutt et al., NeurIPS 2017 (SchNet: A continuous-filter convolutional neural network for modeling quantum interactions). Distance-only invariant encoder; widely used baseline for atom/residue-graph representation. Reuses PyG's InteractionBlock + GaussianSmearing + ShiftedSoftplus, hyperparameters match schnet.yaml.
